subject: Request: Q2 Go-to-Market Headcount & Comp Bands
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps <peopleops@redwoodhr.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Q2 Go-to-Market Headcount & Comp Bands

Team —

Following our Q1 retrospective and the product launch cadence, I’m requesting approval to open a Q2 GTM hiring package. High-level ask below and attached is a spreadsheet with role-level comp bands, ramp assumptions, and P&L impact (HC_Req_Q2.xlsx).

Summary request (total 6 FTEs):
- 3 Account Executives (AE) — mid-market focus (quota-bearing)
- 1 Sales Engineering (SE) — senior, pre-sales complex deals
- 1 Customer Success Manager (CSM) — expansion-led accounts
- 1 Solutions Engineer (associate) — onboarding and enablement (shared across CS/SE)

Why now:
- We have three inbound expansion deals in our pipeline that require AE + SE capacity for Q3 close.
- CS churn remediation plan requires 1 additional CSM to keep ARR churn under 3% per quarter.
- Current SE bench is flat; the senior SE will reduce time-to-demo and technical debt on complex POCs.

Comp bands (proposed, total comp):
- AE (mid): base $95k-$115k + OTE 60% (12k–69k variable)
- SE (senior): base $150k-$175k + discretionary bonus 20%
- CSM: base $120k-$140k + OTE 25%
- Solutions Engineer (associate): base $95k-$110k, band for entry-level IC2

Budget impact:
- Full year run-rate (if hires start by May): incremental ~ $1.15M including benefits and ramp reserves. Detailed numbers in the sheet.

Ask:
- Rishi: approve headcount package and comp bands so PeopleOps can open reqs and initiate offers.
- PeopleOps: please confirm if any constraints (salary caps, title gating) for Q2.

If useful, I can split into two waves (May & July) to align with onboarding calendar. Please respond by COB Thu 3/12 — we need to kick requisitions to meet timelines.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Americas Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q2 Go-to-Market Headcount & Comp Bands

Laura —

Thanks for the clear packet. A few quick operational questions:
- For the 3 AEs, are we hiring SDR-sourced candidates or reps with an existing book? That drives ramp and quota carveouts.
- Do we want to stagger AE hires (1 in May, 2 in July) so quota attainment and comp burn are smoother?
- For SE senior hire: any required tool experience (Vector DB demos, LLM infra) so I can flag recruiters?

From a forecast perspective I’m ok with the 3 AE ask if we get commitment for structured ramp and mentorship (pairing with two tenured AEs for first 90 days). Can we add a short ramp plan to the sheet?

Vivek
Head of Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Q2 Go-to-Market Headcount & Comp Bands

+1 to the ask — a note from CS side: adding this CSM is critical to hit our Q3 expansion targets. A couple of asks to include in the JD and comp:
- Prefer candidate with renewal experience and quota motion ~ $2M ARR book handling.
- Include milestone-based bonus tied to NRR improvement (benchmarked at +4 points over 6 months).

Also tagging onboarding capacity: current CS onboarding trainer bandwidth is limited in June, so if the CSM starts in May, we’ll need contractor support for week 3–6. I’ve added that delta in the attached spreadsheet (tab: OnboardCosts).

Marissa

Laura / team —

On the SE asks: I recommend the senior SE be tagged as \"Principal SE — Inference & Integrations\" and include the following must-haves in the JD:
- Experience implementing LLM inference in production (GPU serving, latency optimization)
- Direct POC ownership with customers (including SSO/KMS conversations)
- Comfortable writing short technical notes for customers (1–2 page solution briefs)

Also — for the associate Solutions Engineer role, please consider making it a 12-month contract-to-hire window; it lets us validate fit during the heavy onboarding months. I can work with PeopleOps on the JD language.

Thanks for the packet and notes. I approve the headcount request conditional on two items before PeopleOps opens the reqs:
1) Laura/Vivek: add the 90-day ramp plan for AEs in the spreadsheet (simple milestones and revenue checkpoint).
2) Marissa: confirm contractor budget for onboarding or move start date for CSM to June.

PeopleOps — please review the attached comp_bands_q2_v2.pdf and flag any gating (approval matrix, director sign-off, salary band constraints). If all clear, proceed to open requisitions and share the req IDs in this thread.
